svg.title: DC voltage source
svg.desc: DC voltage source, Independent DC voltage source, circle with + and − (circuit-analysis and SPICE convention; IEEE 315-1975 §2.5.1 would draw a single battery cell). Not in the Schematex circuit exemplar; drawn to its rules with pins on the engine's anchors; one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: plus (+) (32,8), minus (−) (32,88).
